sources.title: Blue Marble Next Generation w/ Topography and Bathymetry, December 2004 (5400×2700)

files.attribution: Earth texture: NASA Earth Observatory, Blue Marble Next Generation (Reto Stöckli, NASA GSFC), December 2004, topography and bathymetry. Public domain (NASA imagery is not copyrighted).
modifications: no free 3D model of the Earth's interior with separate layers was found (NASA 3D Resources, NIH 3D, Smithsonian 3D), so the layers are generated by the pipeline script
radii to scale for R = 2.4 units (6371 km): OuterCore 3480 km, InnerCore 1220 km; Crust exaggerated to 0.1 units (~265 km) so it is visible, Mantle just below it
Plate_Eurasian and Plate_Indian: schematic raised patches over Central and South Asia, boundary along Makran – Himalaya – Burma arc (not survey data)
Quake_Kemin1911 (42.9° N 76.9° E) and Quake_Suusamyr1992 (42.1° N 73.6° E): approximate epicentre markers
globe turned so 75° E faces +Z (the camera); texture resized 5400×2700 → 1024×512 and encoded WebP (EXT_texture_webp; KTX2 needs toktx, not available in the pipeline yet)
gltf-transform: dedup, prune, weld, EXT_meshopt_compression + quantisation
